tasks.name: Environment Plan
tasks.objective: Produce the Environment Plan for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every area mapped to an art kit and a prop budget
Density, vista and landmark placement rules stated per biome
Interior and exterior transition rules defined

tasks.name: Environment Kit and Dressed Areas
tasks.objective: Produce the Environment Kit and Dressed Areas for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Kit pieces snap to a stated grid and share one material set
Each dressed area meets its prop and draw-call budget
Collision and navmesh coverage present for every playable surface

tasks.name: Environment Performance Review
tasks.objective: Produce the Environment Performance Review for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Measured draw calls, triangles and texture memory attached per area
Culling, LOD and occlusion verified in a profiled build
Any area over budget listed with a concrete fix
